shared_notes: Counts all fires FIRMS detects, from any cause, including agricultural burning and conflict. Static heat sources (type 2) are excluded. Monthly completeness is unknown; known FIRMS data gaps are listed in the docs.
Only type 0 (presumed vegetation fire) is eligible; volcano and offshore detections are also excluded. Fire causes are not classified.

Accuracy is checked against MODIS only up to 2021. From 2022 the MODIS satellites drift in orbit, so 2022–2025 values are checked only by agreement between two VIIRS satellites, not against an independent record.

regions.name: Syria
notes: Forward test against MODIS, 2020–2021 (fitted on 2012–2019): burning days passed every check, with regional monthly error 19.5% against 27.0% for a simple conversion. Hotspots failed one check: regional monthly error 27.5%, slightly worse than the simple conversion's 24.4%. 2021 was overestimated (662 predicted against 490 observed burning days). Local grid-cell errors are 69–77%. August and September 2020 were left out of the test by the sensor-outage rule.

Cells on Syria's borders also cover land in neighbouring countries, but count only Syria's records. 11 of them are shared with Lebanon, whose fires are in the Lebanon view; fires in Turkey, Iraq and Jordan are not shown anywhere.
